blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Governor Humerlito Dolor has laid out the provincial action plan for water and food security amid the effects of the El Niño. The local official made the plan through Executive Order No. 29, Series of 2026, which he posted on his social media page on November 3. The provincial government is lining up alternative water sources, drought‑tolerant seeds, food assistance and medical supplies to cushion the impact of the climate phenomenon, he said. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration has confirmed that “strong‑to‑very‑strong” El Niño conditions are being experienced over the tropical Pacific.
